about_the_game:
Everything is held together by thin strings of coordination and vigilance… until someone starts pulling their own.

Pulled Strings is a game that blends social deduction with survival elements.
It's not just about uncovering the traitor — it's about mastering coordination and acting with purpose.
No one is truly safe, for no one welcomes the coming of darkness — not the Marionettes, not the Killer. Only the Werewolf longs for that...

In every session, players must negotiate and assign roles — and be ready to reshape their duties on the fly.
Danger lurks around every corner, and adaptation is your only lifeline.

⭐ Social deduction meets tense survival

If the Marionettes don’t work together — everyone loses

⭐ A new take on the traitor dynamic:

The Maniac must think twice before every kill.
Sometimes, survival means helping the Marionettes — whether to avoid starving or to keep from becoming the Werewolf’s next prey...

⭐ A genre reimagined

A Victorian mansion, Norse mythology, and eerie marionettes… cooking okroshka.
Can dolls even feel hunger?

⭐ A Marionette that changes everything

Every player is a vital link in the survival chain, shaping the match as it unfolds.
You won’t get far just warming yourself by the fireplace.

⭐ Shape your own rhythm

With dozens of settings to tweak, you can shift the pace of the game entirely — and make it truly yours.

Pulled Strings is in Early Access

We're continuously refining the balance and adding new mechanics based on player feedback.

Key Gameplay Features EA

  • Cooperation is the key to survivalUnmasking the traitor is only part of the challenge. You’ll need to gather resources, keep the fireplace burning, cook okroshka, and perform rituals to hold back the darkness.

  • Three roles — three mindsetsThe Maniac hides among you. The Werewolf turns hunters into prey. And the Marionettes must act as one — or perish apart.

  • Stay alert if you want to surviveMind your hunger, complete the rituals, and don’t forget the fireplace.
    These strange Marionettes… they’re starting to feel a little too human.

  • Rituals against the darknessGather the components of Gleipnir and complete ancient rites to keep the Werewolf and its Familiars at bay. The threat isn’t only among the players.

  • Social manipulation and heated discussionsTalk to other players through voice or text chat. Deceive, mislead, and earn their trust — if you can.

  • Befriend the miceThese tiny creatures might just save your life… when you least expect it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G4560 / AMD A8-7600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GT 610 (512 MB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / NVIDIA GT 770
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Pulled Strings — a social deduction game with survival elements for 3–10 players. Among you hides a Maniac — your goal is not only to find them, but to survive. Keep the fireplace burning, cook okroshka, and stay out of the darkness.
